meta.independent_real_cli_runs_note: This harness never executes the Claude CLI. Every number here replays recorded outcomes; independent real CLI runs are produced only by caver8.live and are NOT part of this report.
meta.replay_caveat: Replay draws the same 132 recorded outcomes ([2, 6] per configuration) again and again. Seed CIs capture schedule and policy randomness only, NOT the uncertainty of the recorded observations themselves.
meta.evidence_label: REPLAY of the REAL v0.11 table (54 configs; v0.11 variants measured >= 2x)

g_sparse.description: stationary, heavy healthy share: only 35% of cases carry a defect (caver8: 80%); train and evaluation from the same regime

g_microdrift.description: three fresh cohorts (steps 1-30, 31-60, 61-90) whose weights move by < 0.05 per family: no family is up-weighted, so there is no real shift to react to

g_partial2.description: only 2 families change at step 30 (timeout 0.30 -> 0.08, schema 0.08 -> 0.30); the other 4 keep their exact weights

g_disappear.description: the most frequent class disappears at step 35: field_value 0.42 -> 0.04, mass spread over schema / abnormal_exit / timeout

g_pingpong.description: repeated abrupt shifts between two non-W_BASE regimes A and B (A 1-20, B 21-45, A 46-65, B 66-90), each segment a fresh cohort

g_density.description: defect density and family mix change together at step 25: sparse near-uniform (30% defective) -> dense schema + field_value heavy (90% defective)

g_sine.description: slow sinusoidal drift between regimes A and B: P(case from B) = 0.5*(1 - cos(2*pi*t/90)), i.e. 0 at t=0, 1 at t=45, back to 0 at t=90; events at the onset (t=8, p=0.08) and at the turn (t=45)

g_burst.description: stable regime steps 1-50, an 8-step burst of abnormal_exit + timeout (51-58), then a return to the SAME stable cohort (59-90, cases already partly probed)

stats_methods.ci: paired normal approx 95% over seeds (primary for criteria)
stats_methods.p_values: two-sided normal; Holm across all supplementary candidate comparisons
stats_methods.pooled: per-seed mean difference across all final scenarios
stats_methods.recovery: paired restricted mean (cap = horizon - change + 1), KM median, RMST, censoring rate

rule.S: each stable-type scenario: dFP vs v0.6 CI lower bound > -0.25
rule.K: each abrupt-type scenario: dFP vs v0.6 lo > 0; dFP vs C2 lo > -0.3; dRecovery vs v0.6 hi < 0
rule.G: every scenario: dFP vs Random, UCB1, SW-UCB, D-UCB lo > 0; dFP vs v0.6 lo > -0.5
rule.FA: where a false-alarm window is defined: FA rate <= v0.6 + 0.05
rule.U: pooled per-seed mean dFP over all scenarios: lo > 0 vs v0.6 AND lo > 0 vs C2
rule.RV: repeated real runs of every config agree (table rv_agreement)
rule.DEV: the candidate passed the shared dev rule (devkit.dev_rule eligible = true)
